developer.title: Developer
developer.noGames: No games yet – click "New game" to get started.
developer.becomeTitle: Publish your games on Game Hub
developer.becomeIntro: Create a studio to publish your HTML5 games. Games are reviewed by an admin before they appear on the hub.

steps.step1: Create a studio (the developer name players will see).
steps.step2: Create a game: name, description, categories, cover image.
steps.step3: Integrate the Game Hub SDK, zip your build (with index.html) and upload it.
steps.step4: An admin playtests and approves → your game goes live and players climb the leaderboard.

developer.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens – used in URLs, can't be changed later.
developer.gameSlugHint: Used in the /games/your-game URL, can't be changed later.

statusHelp.DRAFT: This game is a draft. Upload your first build to submit it for review.
statusHelp.PENDING_REVIEW: Waiting for an admin to playtest and approve. You can still upload new versions.
statusHelp.PUBLISHED: The game is live on the hub. New versions must be approved before replacing the live one.
statusHelp.SUSPENDED: The game was suspended – contact an admin.

developer.buildHint: Up to 50MB, with index.html at the root (or inside one folder). Web files only: html, js, css, images, audio, fonts, wasm…
developer.thumbnailHint: PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 1MB, 16:9 ratio (e.g. 1280×720).
